questions.stem: 手機訊息不斷跳出，打斷我們的思緒，因此要專心讀完一篇長文章已經不容易了。
questions.answer: Messages on our phones pop up constantly, interrupting our thoughts, so it is no longer easy to concentrate on finishing a long article.
accepted_answers: Phone messages keep popping up, interrupting our train of thought, so it is no longer easy to focus on reading a long article to the end.
Messages keep popping up on our phones, interrupting our thinking, so it is now difficult to concentrate long enough to finish a long article.

patterns: 虛主詞 It is + adj. + to V

questions.stem: 定期閱讀紙本書是增強專注力的有效方法，因為我們讀得愈多，就能專心愈久。
questions.answer: Reading printed books regularly is an effective way to strengthen our concentration, because the more we read, the longer we can focus.
accepted_answers: Reading paper books on a regular basis is a useful way to improve our concentration, since the more we read, the longer we can concentrate.
Reading books on paper regularly is an effective method of building our ability to focus, because the more we read, the longer we can stay focused.

1.explanation_zh: 「手機訊息不斷跳出」用 keep popping up 或 pop up constantly；「打斷我們的思緒」是訊息跳出造成的結果，不另寫主詞，用句尾分詞 , interrupting our thoughts。「要專心讀完一篇長文章已經不容易了」真正的主詞是「專心讀完長文章」這件事，用虛主詞 it is no longer easy to concentrate on …（「已經不…了」用 no longer）。
1.strategy_zh: 兩個動作共用主詞、中間沒有連接詞 → 後一個改成分詞；「做某事很難／不容易」→ it is + adj. + to V。
hints: 切成四段：手機訊息不斷跳出／打斷我們的思緒／（因此要）專心讀完一篇長文章／已經不容易了
標的詞彙：message（訊息）、phone（手機）、constantly（不斷地）、interrupt（打斷）、thought（思緒）、concentrate（專心）、article（文章）
句型框架：S + V …, V-ing + O, so it is no longer + adj. + to + V …

2.explanation_zh: 「定期閱讀紙本書」是動作當主詞，用動名詞 Reading printed books regularly（單數，動詞用 is）。「增強專注力的有效方法」用 an effective way to strengthen our concentration。「讀得愈多，就能專心愈久」是「愈…愈…」：the more we read, the longer we can focus（兩個子句都以 the + 比較級開頭，long 的比較級是 longer）。
evidence: 我們讀得愈多，就能專心愈久
2.strategy_zh: 「愈 A 愈 B」→ the + 比較級 + S + V, the + 比較級 + S + V；動作當主詞 → V-ing …（單數）。
hints: 切成四段：定期閱讀紙本書／是增強專注力的有效方法／因為我們讀得愈多／就能專心愈久
標的詞彙：read（閱讀）、printed（印刷的、紙本的）、regularly（定期地）、effective（有效的）、strengthen（增強）、concentration（專注力）
句型框架：V-ing … + is + an effective way to + V …, because the + 比較級 + S + V, the + 比較級 + S + V

references: Messages on our phones pop up constantly, interrupting our thoughts, so it is no longer easy to concentrate on finishing a long article.
Phone messages keep popping up, interrupting our train of thought, so it is no longer easy to focus on reading a long article to the end.
Messages keep popping up on our phones, interrupting our thinking, so it is now difficult to concentrate long enough to finish a long article.

patterns.label_zh: 句尾分詞片語表結果（打斷…）
虛主詞 It ＋形容詞＋不定詞
patterns.frame: so it is no longer + adj. + to + V …

accepted: Messages on our phones pop up constantly
Messages keep popping up on our phones

common_errors.explanation_zh: keep 後面接 V-ing：keep popping up。

common_errors.right: Messages on our phones pop up constantly
common_errors.explanation_zh: 訊息「跳出」是 pop up；jump out 是人或動物跳出來。「手機訊息」寫 phone messages 或 messages on our phones。
逗號後補充結果要用分詞 interrupting；再放一個過去式動詞，句子就有兩個動詞沒有連接（主要子句還是現在式）。
「思緒」用 thoughts 或固定說法 train of thought；thought line 是字面直譯。

accepted: to concentrate on finishing a long article
to focus on reading a long article to the end
to concentrate long enough to finish a long article
to focus on finishing a long article

common_errors.wrong: to concentrate to finish a long article
common_errors.right: to concentrate on finishing a long article
common_errors.explanation_zh: concentrate on 後面接名詞或 V-ing。

common_errors.wrong: to focus finishing a long article
common_errors.right: to focus on finishing a long article
common_errors.explanation_zh: focus 後面要接介系詞 on。

accepted: so it is no longer easy

common_errors.wrong: so concentrate on finishing a long article is no longer easy
common_errors.right: so it is no longer easy to concentrate on finishing a long article
common_errors.explanation_zh: 原形動詞不能當主詞；用虛主詞 it is … to V，把真正的主詞移到後面。

common_errors.wrong: so it is already not easy
common_errors.right: so it is no longer easy
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「已經不…了」表示情況改變，用 no longer／not … anymore；already not 不自然。

traps.literal_error: Phone messages keep popping up, interrupting our mind lines, …
traps.explanation_zh: 「思緒」是抽象名詞，用 thoughts 或 train of thought；不要逐字拼成 mind lines。

traps.literal_error: …, so concentrate on finishing a long article is no longer easy.
traps.explanation_zh: 中文「要專心讀完…已經不容易」的主詞是一個動作；英文用虛主詞 it is no longer easy to …，原形動詞不能當主詞。

bonus.text: With messages constantly popping up on our phones, it is no longer easy to stay focused long enough to finish a long article.
bonus.explanation_zh: with + 受詞 + V-ing 表附帶狀況，把「訊息不斷跳出」濃縮成片語；stay focused long enough to …（專心到足以…）更精準。

1.restructuring_zh: 「因此要專心讀完…已經不容易了」主詞是一個動作，英文改用虛主詞 it 開頭，把 to concentrate on … 放到後面；「打斷我們的思緒」不加主詞，改成句尾分詞 interrupting our thoughts。

references: Reading printed books regularly is an effective way to strengthen our concentration, because the more we read, the longer we can focus.
Reading paper books on a regular basis is a useful way to improve our concentration, since the more we read, the longer we can concentrate.
Reading books on paper regularly is an effective method of building our ability to focus, because the more we read, the longer we can stay focused.

patterns.zh_trigger: 我們讀得愈多，就能專心愈久

accepted: Reading paper books on a regular basis

common_errors.explanation_zh: 動作當主詞要用動名詞 Reading（或 To read），原形動詞不能當主詞。
動名詞片語當主詞視為單數，動詞用 is（不是看 books）。

parts.zh: 是增強專注力的有效方法
accepted: is an effective way to strengthen our concentration
is a useful way to improve our concentration
is an effective method of building our ability to focus
is an effective way to improve our concentration

common_errors.wrong: is an effective way to strengthen our focus power
common_errors.right: is an effective way to strengthen our concentration
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「專注力」是 concentration／attention／the ability to focus，不要逐字寫成 focus power。

common_errors.wrong: is an effective way of strengthen our concentration
common_errors.right: is an effective way to strengthen our concentration
common_errors.explanation_zh: way 後面接 to V 或 of V-ing（of strengthening）。
「愈…愈…」要把 the + 比較級放在子句最前面：the more we read。
the 後面要接比較級 more。

accepted: the longer we can stay focused
the longer we are able to focus

common_errors.wrong: the more longer we can focus
common_errors.explanation_zh: long 的比較級是 longer，不可再加 more。
後半句一樣要把 the + 比較級放在子句前面。

traps.literal_error: Reading printed books regularly is an effective way to strengthen our focus power, …
traps.explanation_zh: 「專注力」是抽象名詞，用 concentration／attention／the ability to focus；不要逐字拼成 focus power。

traps.literal_error: Read printed books regularly is an effective way to strengthen our concentration, …
traps.explanation_zh: 中文直接拿動作當主詞，英文要改成動名詞 Reading …（或 To read …），動詞用單數 is。

bonus.text: The more we immerse ourselves in printed books, the longer we are able to stay focused, which makes regular reading an effective way to sharpen our concentration.
bonus.explanation_zh: immerse oneself in（沉浸於）、sharpen（使敏銳）讓句子更有文采；把「愈…愈…」放在句首再用 which 收尾，是另一種組織方式。

2.restructuring_zh: 「讀得愈多，就能專心愈久」要把比較級移到子句最前面：the more we read, the longer we can focus；「專注力」是名詞 concentration，不要寫成 focus power。

1.translation: Messages keep popping up on our phones, interrupting our thoughts, so it is no longer easy to concentrate on reading a long article to the end.
1.explanation_zh: 「不斷跳出」譯 keep popping up；「打斷我們的思緒」是伴隨結果，用分詞 interrupting；「已經不容易了」譯 it is no longer easy to（虛主詞 + 不定詞）；「專心讀完」譯 concentrate on reading... to the end，「讀完」較難自然地直譯，也可寫 finish reading。

2.translation: Reading printed books regularly is an effective way to strengthen our concentration, because the more we read, the longer we can stay focused.
2.explanation_zh: 「定期閱讀紙本書」用動名詞當主詞；「有效方法」譯 an effective way to；「讀得愈多，就能專心愈久」用 the more..., the longer... 比較句型。

issues_zh: 建議（不影響判定）：第 3 部分可補「to concentrate on reading a long article to the end」。

1.translation: Phone messages keep popping up and interrupting our thoughts, so it is already difficult to concentrate on reading a long article through to the end.
1.explanation_zh: 「不斷跳出」用 keep + V-ing；「打斷我們的思緒」用 interrupt our thoughts；「因此」用 so 連接結果；「要……已經不容易了」用虛主詞 it is already difficult to …；「專心讀完」譯成 concentrate on reading … through to the end，「讀完」有兩種合理譯法，所以信心 medium。

2.translation: Regularly reading printed books is an effective way to strengthen our concentration, because the more we read, the longer we can stay focused.
2.explanation_zh: 「定期閱讀紙本書」用動名詞做主詞（Regularly reading）；「增強專注力」用 strengthen concentration；「我們讀得愈多，就能專心愈久」是 the more …, the longer … 的比較級平行句型；「因為」引導原因副詞子句。

issues_zh: 我把「不斷跳出，打斷我們的思緒」譯成 keep popping up and interrupting our thoughts（兩個動作並列、同受 keep 支配），沒有句尾分詞片語（, interrupting …），所以 PART 沒有自然用到；中文是兩個動作並列，用 and interrupt 同樣自然，PART 沒被引出。
另外 NFSUBJ 那一部分的 accepted 都以 so 開頭，但中文「因此」不在任何一個部分的 zh 文字裡，改用 therefore／as a result 的學生會被判不符。
